buffer_months.description: Months of average net burn to keep as a buffer for the funding gap; left out, the setting planning.buffer_months (6).

cash_adjustment.description: Added to the books' cash at the start, such as money already committed; 0 for none.

costs.description: The direct-cost percentages and the salary increase.

funding.description: The money planned to be raised or received; none of it is received yet, so runway is also shown without it (FR-PLN-03).

headcount.description: The team and the planned hires.

last_actual.description: The last month with complete actuals (YYYY-MM): the forecast starts the month after. Left out, the last closed month, else the month before today.

opex.description: The other operating expenses, each a monthly base that grows, plus a share of revenue.

scenarios.description: The scenarios; left out, Base, Best and Worst with the workbook's levers. Custom ones carry their own levers and buffer.

tax.description: What the tax estimate needs beyond the sg-cit pack.
